meta.notes: Dataset follows the parent-approved 280-row scope from the current Items page: Cursed Worm is deduped into Quest Items, and the Portals section includes the seven trial rows counted by the approved line-start parser plus the nine visible portal rows. Item image pass downloaded and wired all current wiki item icons available for the approved scope; seven trial portal rows remain text-only because the wiki exposes no matching icon files for those commented portal trials.
